\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಮುಕ್ಕಾಲು} (mukkālu)}{ಮುಕ್ಕಾಲು (mukkālu)}]{\kn{ಮುಕ್ಕಾಲು} (mukkālu) — three quarters}

\label{lesson:KA-C285-mukkalu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for time, then the Kannada for sometimes.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಮುಕ್ಕಾಲು}}
\textbf{\kn{ಮುಕ್ಕಾಲು}} — \emph{mukkālu} — \textquotedblleft{}three quarters\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಮುಕ್ಕಾಲು}} (\emph{mukkālu}) is native Dravidian: \emph{muk-}, the form of \textquotedblleft{}three\textquotedblright{} before a consonant (DEDR 5052), and \emph{kālu}, \textquotedblleft{}leg, quarter\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 1479): \textquotedblleft{}three quarters\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{cousinweb}
